measurement_rules: Zero severe stretch is necessary technical evidence, not proof of natural animation
Signed tetrahedral volume of an open mesh is diagnostic only, not an enclosed-volume acceptance gate
Sleeve-centre path length does not bound local edge distortion
Source validation does not substitute for exported GLB validation
When keys are densified, sample between the new keys as well
Record absolute world floor contact, not height relative to the mesh minimum
